blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Stable blocks 48443292 and 48443381 (2026-11-27T13:06:01Z to 13:07:03Z), all four VaultV2 gate addresses (receiveSharesGate, sendSharesGate, receiveAssetsGate, sendAssetsGate) are zero. setReceiveSharesGate, setSendSharesGate, and setReceiveAssetsGate are permanently abdicated (abdicated = 1), preventing future share-transfer or withdrawal-recipient gates on the immutable Sourcify-verified VaultV2 core; setSendAssetsGate remains mutable at zero delay and affects deposits/mints only. oracleRisk.summary: At Stable blocks 48443381 to 48443578 (2026-11-27), the complete one-adapter, one-market census identifies a single weETH/PYUSD Morpho Blue market at 86% LLTV priced by MorphoChainlinkOracleV2 0x9529b9b10f6784a28445ca77465b5ac6aa67639f. Its 2557-byte runtime matches Sourcify MorphoChainlinkOracleV2 outside declared immutables and CBOR tail, composing three RedStone 8-decimal feeds: BASE_FEED_1 weETH_FUNDAMENTAL (0xd57b79401956be4872d3d03f0c920639335e350f), BASE_FEED_2 ETH (0x457be3c697c644bf329c2c3ea79ebf1d254d603a), and QUOTE_FEED_1 PYUSD (0x1c30da143e97c228102a5cae3960dbbb41321604). All three feed proxies read from one shared RedStone adapter proxy (0x6165211bef5bf1fe2697dbaa912d907e9fd4c5b1, Sourcify exact_match StableMultiFeedAdapterWithoutRoundsV1 implementation 0xbd7178abfba583730deb86db2ba5e7ea167158c0) requiring 3-of-5 authorized RedStone primary-prod signers with a 30-hour adapter staleness cap. All four RedStone proxies share ProxyAdmin 0x4154f0e4dc70dfa4219309fbea34322225e17b68 owned by 2-of-3 Safe 0x42f01e06b816eb8922a29ba12f69c20faf92fc92. The Morpho composer discards updatedAt and has no fallback oracle; weETH_FUNDAMENTAL reflects protocol redemption value rather than secondary-market weETH/ETH discounts.

branches.fallbackBehavior: MorphoChainlinkOracleV2 has no alternate oracle or circuit breaker; it composes BASE_FEED_1 * BASE_FEED_2 / QUOTE_FEED_1 with SCALE_FACTOR 1e16 and discards updatedAt without a local freshness guard. All three RedStone feed proxies share one upgradeable StableMultiFeedAdapterWithoutRoundsV1 (3-of-5 authorized signers, 30-hour MAX_DATA_STALENESS, authorized updater allowlist) and one ProxyAdmin; a reverting or stale adapter leg blocks pricing with no independent provider failover.

collateralParameters.note: Immutable Morpho market LLTV 86.0% for bridged weETH collateral on Stable.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Sourcify-verified Morpho Blue on Stable (0xa40103088a899514e3fe474cd3cc5bf811b1102e) checks borrower health against IOracle.price() and immutable 86% LLTV; permissionless liquidators repay PYUSD debt and seize weETH collateral, subject to StableChain execution and liquidator funding.
branches.backstop: No committed depositor loss backstop is established. Galaxy Curation LLC terms disclaim loss-prevention guarantees and cap contractual liability, and Morpho Blue liquidation provides no funded insurance pool or make-whole obligation.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: When borrower collateral is exhausted during liquidation, Morpho Blue realizes residual badDebtAssets by reducing market totalBorrowAssets and totalSupplyAssets. MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2 realAssets() transmits that reduction into VaultV2 NAV, with no guaranteed par recovery.
